title: Delulu or Solulu: Single at the Wedding Table
old_caption:
Sagittarius got seated at table 7: singles, caught the bouquet by accident and survived the aunt question.
The meter's verdict: having the best night anyway. Delulu or solulu?

title: Nature Documentary: The Situationship
old_caption:
Here we observe two stars sharing a sofa, sharing fries, and never once saying what they are.
Then Libra does something very rare: just asks. Even the narrator wasn't ready.

title: What They Said vs What They Meant: Maybe I'll Come
old_caption:
Said: "maybe I'll come." Meant: "I'm scared nobody will talk to me." A whole party, translated one sign at a time.
Wait for the host's translation. Which line have you said this month?

title: Your side first
old_caption:
Ever watched someone scrape a windshield very, very slowly?
It was clearing your side first.

title: Built you in snow
old_caption:
When your Aries builds the worst snowman you've ever seen.
Turns out it was a portrait. Of you.

title: Found it
old_caption:
Why is there so much tape on one tiny present?
Because they kept looking for the thing you lost.

title: Pre-warmed
old_caption:
Your coat is being held hostage by the radiator.
Some people say I love you with a warm coat.

title: You said it once
old_caption:
Why does your Capricorn keep writing in that notebook?
Every little thing you mentioned once. Remembered.

title: Baked your sign
old_caption:
Waiting all evening while someone kneads the same dough?
Worth it when the bread comes out shaped like your sign.

title: Both, side by side
old_caption:
Libra cannot pick an ornament. Classic.
Sometimes the answer is both, on the same branch.
